Oct 19 repository advanced 14 commits (#54, #57–#70) to 30c476455c20: froze v0.1 at content/versions/0.1/spec.mdx (/docs/0.1/spec) and opened Draft 0.2 at content/versions/0.2/spec.mdx (/docs/spec) with content/shared/changelog.mdx. Draft 0.2 introduces breaking security & identity hardening: HTTPS everywhere (#67), exact major.minor matching before 1.0 (#67), no credential forwarding on redirects & anti-SSRF loopback/private/link-local blocking (#68), one issuer per Company (#54), unified client & session assertion aud=auth.issuer with <=300s lifetime & jti replay protection (#68), distinct ES256 DPoP key pair per User ID & anonymous browsing User IDs (#62/#65/#68), MCP server token-type selection (DPoP-only when dpop_signing_alg_values_supported lists ES256, Bearer otherwise, mandatory resource parameter) (#64/#69), sticky account binding across sign-out (#70), and Section 8 capability-gap feedback.endpoint (#59).

Draft v1 operations extension (moved to content/versions/0.2/extensions/operations.mdx in #57; v0.1 frozen at content/versions/0.1/extensions/operations.mdx). Commits #69 and #70 (Oct 19, 30c476455c20) enforce that an operation proposed in a signed-in Session can be used ONLY by a Session signed in to the same account at request time (returning sign_in_required to signed-out tokens), replace extension_required with rate_limited in the Operations error table, and require MCP tools needing Operations to return ordinary tool errors.
